Class CardGame

java.lang.Object
CardGame
public class CardGame extends Object
Represents a card game with a deck, hand, and prize pile.

  • Method Details

    • fillDeck

      public void fillDeck(int numPokemon, int numTrainer, int numEnergy)
      Fills a deck with a specified number of Pokemon, Trainer, and Energy cards.
      Parameters:
      numPokemon - The number of Pokemon cards to add to the deck
      numTrainer - The number of Trainer cards to add to the deck
      numEnergy - The number of Energy cards to add to the deck

    • drawHand

      public void drawHand()
      Draws 7 cards from the deck randomly and adds them to the hand and removes them from the deck.

    • checkHand

      public boolean checkHand()
      Checks if the player's hand contains any Pokemon cards.
      Returns:
      true if the hand contains at least one Pokemon card, false otherwise

    • shuffle

      public void shuffle()
      Shuffles the deck of cards.

    • run

      public int run(int reshuffles, int numPokemon)
      Simulates a card game by filling the deck, shuffling it, drawing a hand, and checking if the hand is valid.
      Parameters:
      reshuffles - The number of reshuffles that have been done so far
      numPokemon - The number of Pokemon cards in the deck
      Returns:
      The updated number of reshuffles after checking the hand

    • monte1

      public void monte1()
      Simulates multiple runs of a card game with varying numbers of Pokemon cards. Calculates the probability of reshuffling needed for a valid hand in the game for each number of Pokemon cards.

    • monte2

      public void monte2()
      Runs a simulation of Pokemon rare candies and prints the resulting matrix. The matrix represents the simulation results.

    • placePrizeCards

      public void placePrizeCards()
      Places 6 prize cards from the deck into the prize pile. The method iterates through the deck and adds the first card to the prize pile, then removes that card from the deck. This process is repeated 6 times.

    • openingHand

      public void openingHand(CardGame player)
      Simulates the opening hand phase for a player in a card game. The player draws a hand, checks if the hand is valid, reshuffles the deck if needed, and gets prize cards once the opening hand is ready.
      Parameters:
      player - The player for whom the opening hand is being simulated

    • pokemonRareCandiesSimulation

      public String[][] pokemonRareCandiesSimulation()
      Simulates the chance of bricking based on the number of Rare Candies in a deck of 60 cards. The simulation runs for 10,000 test cases and calculates the probability of not bricking.
      Returns:
      A 2D array containing the number of Rare Candies and the corresponding chance of not bricking.

    • probabilityOfPrized

      public static BigInteger probabilityOfPrized(int totalRareCandies, int prizedCandies)
